subject.title: CLI: openclaw message send hangs indefinitely after successful delivery

question: Should gateway owners accept the open PR's guarded private `ws._socket` unref approach as the canonical fix for this CLI hang?
rationale: The issue itself is clear enough to keep open, but the remaining action is a maintainer merge-risk choice on the linked PR's private dependency surface and proof level, not a new duplicate repair job.

options.title: Accept and land the linked PR
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89792 if maintainers accept the guarded `ws._socket` dependency and mechanism-level proof for this lifecycle bug.

options.title: Require full live CLI proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a redacted live `openclaw message send --json` run shows delivery, complete JSON output, and natural process exit.

options.title: Pause for a public shutdown design
options.body: Reject or pause the current PR if gateway owners want a shutdown mechanism that avoids private `ws` internals.

recommendation.title: Accept and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89792 if maintainers accept the guarded `ws._socket` dependency and mechanism-level proof for this lifecycle bug.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior gateway lifecycle work on lingering socket shutdown behavior.
